'''Skull Rock''' in northeastern [[Durotar]] {{coords|55|11|Durotar}} is one of several holdouts of the [[Burning Blade]] clan in Durotar. The leader of the Burning Blade within Skull Rock is the [[orc]] [[warlock]], [[Gazz'uz]]. The quest {{quest|Skull Rock|Skull Rock}} is performed within this cave.
